data.rationale: The proposal captures the core flow (GitHub user lookup, followers, top repo stars/language, email with the right subject and body template, discard), but it misses the blog parameter and the separate-tab blog visit, treats the latest post vaguely as "blog or pinned item", turns the fixed hiring@example.com recipient into a parameter, and adds an unneeded Users filter step and a vague "send or discard", so an automation couldn't be built reliably without the blog URL.
